response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep technical breadth across languages and systems, and demonstrable leadership in open-source and team mentorship, but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade GenAI or cloud-based RAG systems, with only recent AI-agent work at re:cinq and no clear metrics on vector databases, multi-agent frameworks, or LLM optimization.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript/Node.js and cloud-native tooling (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes)
Proven technical leadership through open-source projects, workshops, and mentoring across teams
Recent direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years dedicated to AI/ML production systems; most AI work is recent
Missing explicit experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM performance optimization
Limited documentation of enterprise customer-facing technical leadership or AI-to-legacy system integrations

key_factors.factor: Lack of proven GenAI production history
